given: a SKU's stock record at a location carries a combined tracking code
when: a warehouse operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: the combined tracking code is shown for that SKU's stock at that location
architectural_notes: E2E path over the JSON boundary (R5/NFR-F1-5): the combined tracking code is a persisted column on the stock record (app/models/), read through app/repositories/ -> app/services/ and returned verbatim by app/routes/ (boundary); the React SPA (client/) displays it on the location row. The boundary passes the stored value through without formatting. Verified by the R4 branch integration test (NFR-F1-4) asserting the boundary returns the combined tracking-code field for a record that carries one, plus a SPA client component test asserting the tracking-code text is rendered on the row.

independence.rationale: AC1 covers the per-location rows (location + quantity); AC2 adds the tracking-code display, which can be broken (code missing or blank) while the location rows still render correctly, and vice versa
